backend/main.mo: Primary Motoko canister implementing auth-gated user profiles, calculation history, and data types for math/physics/chemistry problem solving.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten one‑sentence summaries of all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme CSS defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up providers and switching between solver and history pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Wrapper requiring authentication before showing protected children.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrated with Internet Identity and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Shows a dialog prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter and save their name.
frontend/src/components/Branding.tsx: Branding component displaying logo, title, and subtitle.
frontend/src/components/common/States.ts: Provides reusable UI components for loading, error, empty, and skeleton states.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with app branding, page navigation, and login/logout controls.
frontend/src/components/history/HistoryL: Renders a table of past calculations with summaries, timestamps, and options to rerun or delete entries.
frontend/src/components/history/historyS: Generates short summaries for math, physics, or chemistry inputs based on their type.
frontend/src/components/inputs/chemistry: Defines chemistry topic configurations including names, descriptions, and required input fields.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Chemistry: Form for selecting a chemistry topic, entering required values, validating input, and submitting a calculation.
frontend/src/components/inputs/MathSolve: Form for entering and solving math expressions with validation and example shortcuts.
frontend/src/components/inputs/physics/p: Defines physics topic configurations with formulas and variable metadata for the solver UI.
frontend/src/components/inputs/PhysicsSo: Form for selecting a physics topic, entering known variables, choosing a solve-for target, and running a calculation.
frontend/src/components/ModeSelector.tsx: Tabs for selecting math, physics, or chemistry solver mode.
frontend/src/components/results/MathStep: Renders a list of math solution steps with descriptions, calculations, and results.
frontend/src/components/results/Solution: Displays loading state, empty state, or full solution including final answer and step-by-step details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, state, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for running calculations, managing history, and handling user profiles via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes, variables, and custom scrollbars.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query and identity providers and imports global styles.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx: Displays calculation history with actions to clear, delete, or rerun items, wrapped in auth and profile checks.
frontend/src/pages/SolverPage.tsx: Main solver page managing mode state, loading state, and rendering the appropriate solver form with a solution panel.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameter cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, requirements, versioning, and image assets for the AI calculator app.
